description: Framework-owned baseline ontology for SCARAG source, evidence, lifecycle, provenance, confidence, and profile semantics.

concepts.plain_meaning: The original file, document, spreadsheet, page, or record
A meaningful part of the source, such as a section, table, page, row group, or extracted block
The chunk or retrievable unit used by the system
What kind of source this is: policy, FAQ, report, table, note, etc.
Whether the evidence is active, retired, pending review, deleted, stale, etc.
Where the evidence came from and how it was produced
Reasons to trust, weaken, or abstain from using the evidence
The traceable reference shown to the user
A lightweight set of domain-specific hints
A domain term, synonym, category, or controlled vocabulary item

notes.metadata: Metadata is a framework contract surface represented by canonical evidence fields.
notes.answer: Answer is a response-layer artifact produced from retrieved evidence under grounding policy.
